docs.action: Write a page or import one from Notion. Type / to add tables, to-do lists and databases.

track.action: Press C anywhere in Track to create an issue, then add it to a cycle.

crm.action: Add a deal to the pipeline and drag it between stages as it moves.

notes.action: Write a note and file it in a notebook. Tags help you find it later.

board.action: Open a blank board or a template and add stickies, shapes and arrows.

link.action: Paste a long URL, pick the slug and see clicks by country and device.

cal.action: Set the length and your hours, then share the link so people can book you.

welcome.subject: Your zerosoft account is ready
welcome.preheader: Where to start and how to find things.
welcome.heading: Welcome to zerosoft
body: Your workspace is set up. Every app shares the same account, search and permissions.
To find anything, press ⌘K (Ctrl+K on Windows). To ask the assistant, press ⌘J.
Over the next few days we'll send a few short emails about what's left to set up. If you've already done it, you won't get them.

setup_first_item.subject: Create {thing} in {app}
setup_first_item.heading: Create {thing}
body: You picked {app} when you signed up and haven't created anything there yet.
{action}

setup_import.subject: Bring your data over from {tool}
setup_import.preheader: The importer copies what you already have.
setup_import.heading: Import from {tool}
body: You told us you're coming from {tool}. The {app} importer brings your data in and shows a preview before saving.
Everything you import lives in your workspace and can be edited or deleted like anything else.

setup_calendar.subject: Connect your calendar to Cal
setup_calendar.preheader: So nobody books a time you're already busy.
setup_calendar.heading: Connect your calendar
body: Cal can't see your calendar yet. Connect Google, Outlook or iCloud and your busy times stop showing as free.
New bookings are added to that calendar automatically.

setup_whatsapp.subject: Connect your WhatsApp line to Groups
setup_whatsapp.preheader: Scan a QR code and your chats show up in the inbox.
setup_whatsapp.heading: Connect a WhatsApp line
body: Groups doesn't have a line connected yet. Scan the QR code from WhatsApp on your phone and your groups show up in the shared inbox.
From there you assign chats, leave internal notes and reply with your team.

team_invite.subject: Bring your team into {team}
team_invite.preheader: Seats aren't billed, so invite whoever you need.
team_invite.heading: Invite your team
body: Right now you're the only person in {team}. Invite teammates by email or share an invite link.
You choose which apps each person sees and their role. Seats aren't billed.

team_pending.subject: Your invites to {team} haven't been accepted
team_pending.preheader: You can resend them or share the link another way.
team_pending.heading: Pending invites
body: You sent invites to {team} a few days ago and nobody has accepted yet. Sometimes they land in spam.
In Members you can resend them, or copy the invite link and send it over chat.

feature_assistant.subject: Ask the assistant with ⌘J
feature_assistant.preheader: It searches, summarizes and creates across your apps.
feature_assistant.heading: The assistant
body: Press ⌘J (Ctrl+J on Windows) on any screen and type what you need: "summarize the open issues in this cycle" or "make a page from yesterday's notes".
It works with your permissions and asks you to confirm before changing anything.

feature_voice.subject: Dictate instead of typing
feature_voice.preheader: Hold Alt+Space in any zerosoft text field.
feature_voice.heading: Voice: dictation and meeting notes
body: Hold Alt+Space (Option+Space on Mac) in any text field, talk, and let go. The text appears where your cursor was.
In Voice you can also record meetings and keep the transcript and a summary.

feature_desktop.subject: Dictate into any app with zerosoft for desktop
feature_desktop.preheader: Mac and Windows: dictation on a shortcut and system notifications.
feature_desktop.heading: The desktop app
body: The zerosoft app for Mac and Windows opens your workspace in its own window and adds what the browser can’t do.
Dictation in any app: hold Option + Space (Ctrl + Alt + Space on Windows), talk, and let go. The text is pasted where your cursor is.
Mentions, messages and alerts arrive as system notifications, with the unread count on the icon.
It’s about 3 MB and you sign in with your usual account.

feature_mcp.subject: Connect Claude or another MCP client to zerosoft
feature_mcp.preheader: Your agent reads and creates in your apps with your permissions.
feature_mcp.heading: zerosoft over MCP
body: zerosoft has an MCP server. Connect it to Claude, Cursor or another client and your agent can search, read and create issues, pages or contacts with your permissions.
The guide covers how to connect it and what each app supports.

tip_search.subject: One shortcut for everything: ⌘K
tip_search.preheader: Search all your apps from one place.
tip_search.heading: Find anything with ⌘K
body: ⌘K (Ctrl+K on Windows) searches every app at once: pages, issues, contacts, boards and notes.
You can also use it to jump to an app or create something new without the mouse.

reengage.subject: Your zerosoft workspace is waiting
reengage.preheader: Everything is where you left it.
reengage.heading: It's been a while
body: Your workspace is exactly how you left it. If something didn't work the way you expected, tell us with the feedback button in the app.
If you'd rather not get reminders, the unsubscribe link is below.

digest.preheader: What happened in your workspace in the last 7 days.
digest.heading: Your week in {team}
body: Here's what happened in your workspace in the last 7 days.
